paragraphs: Mentioned in Zevachim 102a according to Dikdukei Soferim; our reading is R' Chiyya of Yusetanya.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: דק״ס is read contextually as Dikdukei Soferim; its Chisda reading remains Hyman’s attribution, not a new collation.
קב. gives Zevachim 102a under the period convention, while earlier machine קיב gives 112. No named edition or fresh print check settles this discrepancy.
Supplied וגרכא is read contextually as the version/reading formula, without changing Hebrew. Chisda and Chiyya remain the two reported names. Heading Rav is full; Chiyya’s title remains R'.
